_comment: Corrections to what we read out of a gift's Korean effect text. Keys are gift ids. `conditions` corrects the activation clauses the party is judged against; `skillTriggers` and `formationSlots` correct which skills the effect keys off (see scripts/lib/parse-skill-triggers.ts). Each key wins on its own and replaces the parse wholesale — set one to [] when the parser invented something that is not there. See the add-curated-override skill for the shape of each condition type.
